lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Mist clings to Sunken Ford's shattered bridge-pilings as heavy boots churn the red-stained shallows.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Grok'tar's raiders chained the toll-gate shut from the far bank. Archers, keep their parapet suppressed.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: Watch the submerged flagstones ten paces left—slip off that shelf and full mail drags you straight under.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Shields lock on the causeway! Drive a wedge through the gate before their runners bring oil-pots.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: Mind those iron spikes along the timber sill—I'm not hammering dents out of every greave tonight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Pike-shafts splinter against notched broadswords as the vanguard forces the ford's central pier.

camera_notes: Low tracking pan across water-level bridge pilings, rising to frame the bottleneck clash at the toll-gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Black fen-water drips steadily from vaulted stone ribs inside the flooded Sunken Sanctum.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Don't touch the green lichen on those altar steps—one scrape burns like hot lye for three days.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Mordred's cultists used the lower crypt to smelt counterfeit border-scrip. Check every chest.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Look at the wax seals on these crates—official Thornwick Mint stamps, carved fresh this season.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Someone inside the garrison sold the dies. Keep the plates wrapped in oiled cloth for evidence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Lantern light glints off wet flagstones as the company gathers the stamped iron plates.

camera_notes: Slow push-in from the flooded nave toward the flickering brazier beside the cracked reliquary.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Rain drums against weathered oak planks as scouts spot grey banners cresting the northern ridge.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Velen's outriders moved faster than expected. If they cross Alder Bridge, Thornwick's granaries burn.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: I wedged iron spikes into the plank joints—buy me ten heartbeats and they'll break their ankles.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Form two ranks behind the toll-booth. Nothing crosses that timber unless it pays in iron.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: I've moored the punt downstream in case the flank buckles, though my money's on your pikes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Horns bray through the drizzle as heavy infantry thunders onto the narrow wooden span.

camera_notes: High diagonal angle overlooking the narrow bridge span, snapping down to eye-level behind the defender shield-wall.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Blue woodsmoke threads quietly beneath dripping pine boughs where Greywood's border path narrows.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Whoever brewed that kettle used dried willow-bark and wild bog-myrtle. Good for fever, terrible for taste.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Hold your blades—the snares along this trail are set for wolves, not border levies.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Still, keep your hands near your hilts. Foresters around here hate tax-collectors worse than gnolls.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: Can't blame them. Half the timber-men lost their sledges when the crown doubled bridge-tithes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: A goose-fletched arrow thuds into a pine trunk inches from the captain's boot as shadows stir.

camera_notes: Tight woodland framing through dense pine trunks, whipping sharply to the embedded arrow on the final beat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Torches sputter along Ashbrook's mud-choked palisade while siege-ladders lean against the gatehouse.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Commander Velen calls for parley—says he'll spare the townsfolk if we surrender the Mint dies.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Look at his crossbowmen behind the baggage carts. He's buying time to flank the postern.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: My bellows are hot and the boiling pitch is ready. Say the word and we spoil his manners.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Drop oil on the dry brush right of the gate—one spark will cut his reserves in half.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: No parley. Sound the horn and hit his vanguard before those ladders touch timber.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: War-horns split the wet night air as pitch-pots crash onto the causeway below.

camera_notes: Over-the-shoulder shot from the palisade walkway looking down at Velen's torchlit vanguard, tilting up at the horn blast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Where peat-bog gives way to cracked red clay, a salt-eaten obelisk marks the southern border.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: Three generations of ferrymen never stepped past that stone. Nothing grows south except debt and vipers.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Fill every empty flask from the last sweet spring here. Beyond this ridge, water tastes like chalk.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: I wrapped the spare bowstrings in tallow-cloth. Dry wind splits ungreased hemp before noon.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Check your straps and leave the heavy mud-boots on the baggage cart. Redmarsh waits ahead.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Column forward. Keep three paces between files so the dust doesn't blind the rear.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Cold northern drizzle ends abruptly at the stone shadow as a dry copper gust sweeps the vanguard.

camera_notes: Wide establishing shot contrasting green-grey northern mist on the left with arid ochre dust on the right.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Red sandstone walls tower above Twin Passes where bleached wagon-ribs jut from drifted alkali.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Horn-bowmen on both ledges! Keep shields angled up or they'll pin us like beetles in a jar.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Forget the wagons—save the water-barrels! Each cask is worth forty crowns at the outpost!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Rangers clear the west ridge first while heavy infantry holds the choke! Move!

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: Stay out of the white powder-drifts—alkali burns wet leather straight through to the heel!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Sling-stones crack against iron helms as dust clouds swallow the narrow canyon floor.

camera_notes: Rapid vertical tilt from the canyon floor up to shadowy bowmen perched along the jagged rim.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Blue lightning stutters across a fractured quartz spire atop the eastern salt-plateau.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Saelen's sappers drove iron wedges straight into the primary ley-vein! Look at that hairline crack!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Can your wards stabilize the stone before the whole ridge collapses into the basin?

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Only if you keep his hexers off my back for sixty heartbeats while I bind the fracture!

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Raiders climbing the scree from the south! Form a ring around the scholar!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Gravel trembles underfoot as the wounded monolith hums with dangerous astral pressure.

camera_notes: Dutch-angle medium shot circling Zahra and the glowing quartz crack as raiders crest the background ridge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Iron shackles clatter against red stone terraces inside the stifling heat of Deep Quarry.

lines.speaker: field-miner-tomas
lines.line: The overseers locked the upper lift-gate and flooded the lower sump with scorpion-smoke!

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Break open that tool-crib—there's fifty heavy picks and iron wedges stacked behind the padlock.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Arm every miner who can swing a haft. We take the lift-house before Gorrathul's guards regroup.

lines.speaker: field-miner-tomas
lines.line: You heard the captain, lads! Pay back three winters of ironstone dust in one shift!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Dozens of scarred miners hoist heavy picks as the rusted lift-chains groan upward.

camera_notes: Crane shot ascending alongside the wooden quarry lift-cage as armed miners rally across stacked terraces.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Inside Morvessa's canvas pavilion, brass scales gleam beside stacks of confiscated caravan ledgers.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Look at those tax-writs—she taxed the same salt-convoy four times between here and the coast.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Worse than greed, Bram. These silver bars were bound for Oakhaven's shipwrights—paid in advance to block the harbor.

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: She starved three wells to buy privateer galleys. Let the desert vultures balance her books.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Pack the bullion for our war-chest and burn the false liens. Nobody in Redmarsh pays her tithe again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Parchment curls black in the brazier as red dust blows cleanly through the open tent flaps.

camera_notes: Close-up on brass scales and burning parchment rolls, pulling back to reveal the company inspecting the bullion.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Half-buried basalt tablets jut like broken teeth from the dry bed of the ancient inland sea.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Hold the lantern steady—this First-Compact boundary glyph predates the Schism by four centuries.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Careful around the base. Sand-lurkers nest beneath warm stone slabs during midday glare.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: The inscription warns that the Threshold seals beneath Crown and Ember draw power from these desert aquifers.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Take your charcoal rubbings fast. If Gorrathul drained the cisterns to feed the caldera, we're already behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Wind hisses across carved runes as distant thunder rolls over Ironheart Bastion.

camera_notes: Low-angle shot framing the towering carved stele against the hazy red horizon while Zahra traces the glyphs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Switchback ramps wind up Ironheart Bastion's sheer cliffside beneath rusted sluice-gates.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: One narrow ramp, zero cover, and boiling oil-cauldrons perched above the main arch.

lines.speaker: field-miner-tomas
lines.line: My quarry lads spotted an old drainage culvert ten yards right—tight squeeze, dry stone.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: If it spares my pack-mules from burning pitch, I'll crawl through on my belly.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Vanguard draws their fire on the ramp while sappers breach the culvert. Spring the trap on my horn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Shields lock overhead as the first stones clatter down from the bastion battlements.

camera_notes: Sweeping vertical pan up the jagged cliff switchbacks toward the looming iron sluice-gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Tar-smoke hangs thick over Oakhaven's timber slips where half-built carracks rest in wooden cradles.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Vesperion's arsonists rigged pitch-barrels under my flagship's keel! Cut those fuses before they catch!

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: Privateers swarming off the pier! Keep them away from the oak-timber sheds!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Douse the barrels first, then drive every boarder back into the grey surf!

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: I kicked two of their slow-matches into the bilge-ditch already, boss—pay up later!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Buckets of seawater hiss against smoking tar as steel clashes beside the towering hulls.

camera_notes: Dynamic tracking shot weaving beneath massive wooden ship-ribs toward the burning pitch-barrels.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Salt-crusted iron bars seal Baron Vane's subterranean bullion vault beneath the harbor customs house.

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: Told you that rusty sea-grate led straight under his counting room! Smell that dry silver!

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: While Oakhaven's pickets ate boiled kelp, Vane hoarded enough coin to pay three mercenary companies.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Haul the chests up to Kors's drydocks. Every crown goes into hull-iron, powder, and bandages.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Set aside two bars for my surgical tent—clean vinegar and linen cost more than broadswords lately.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Heavy locks give way under a pry-bar as stamped coastal crowns spill across damp flagstones.

camera_notes: Interior dolly shot moving through the narrow culvert grate into the torchlit bullion vault.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Barnacle-encrusted arches emerge briefly from foaming grey breakers as the tide hits dead low.

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: Four bells till the swell rushes back in, boss! Whatever's inside that armory, grab it fast!

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Watch your footing on that green kelp—a broken ankle down here means drowning before sunset.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Those bronze ballast-plates on the altar are pre-Schism alloy. Salt water never even pitted them.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Sweep the side-chambers in pairs and fall back the instant the surf touches the outer steps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Cold spray bursts through cracked sea-windows as drowned sentinels stir in the shallow pools.

camera_notes: Low angle inside the flooded archway looking out toward crashing waves and the retreating tide.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Rain patters on canvas triage tents pitched behind Oakhaven's battered seawall.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Three sergeants pulled out of the breach alive, though two won't lift a tower shield again till winter.

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: The city council finally unlocked their crossbow armory once they saw your banner on the pier.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Distribute the bolts to your seawall pickets. We sail against Kael's blockade at first light.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Take my father's bone-saw in your surgical kit—it cuts clean when rusted field blades fail.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Lanterns sway gently in the coastal gale as wounded soldiers sleep beside stacked medicine chests.

camera_notes: Quiet, intimate medium shot inside the lantern-lit surgical tent, contrasting with rain outside the flap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Grappling hooks bite deep into charred oak rails as Oakhaven's carracks lock hulls with Admiral Kael's flagship.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Hold the gangplanks! If their marines cut our lines, the current drifts us straight onto the reef!

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: Archers on the forecastle—clear their quarterdeck before Kael's bell-toller finishes his chant!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Over the rail! Take the helm and strike his black standard!

lines.speaker: npc-pip-mudlark
lines.line: Watch the greased planks midships—they smeared whale-blubber across the boards!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Burning sails collapse into the churning bay as steel rings across blood-slick decks.

camera_notes: High-angle swaying shipboard camera tracking across the locked gangplanks amid billowing smoke.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Salt-bleached ship ribs arch like a whale's skeleton above Vesperion's cliffside wreck-shrine.

lines.speaker: npc-lyra-warden
lines.line: Every ship lost along the Iron Coast for twenty years had its brass bell hung in this gallery.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Listen to that low hum—he bound the drowned crews to silence anyone who sails south.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Shatter the master chime on the altar. Our fleet crosses the strait without his toll.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: One swing of a shipwright's maul ought to cure that brass of singing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: A deafening discordant clang echoes across the cliffs as hundreds of bells crack simultaneously.

camera_notes: Wide symmetrical shot down the aisle of hanging ship-bells, shaking violently as the central bell shatters.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Orange glare pulses up through iron grates carved directly into Ironcamp's volcanic foundry floor.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Meteor-slag from the Greystone breach and glacier-salt from the northern peaks—that's what holds an edge here.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Vok lost half his clan keeping these vents open while High Command sealed the northern passes behind us.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Forge what the vanguard needs. When we march on the Gauntlet, High Command will answer for those sealed gates.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Bring me an Anvilmaw jawbone if you cross the slag-pits, and I'll temper something worthy of a throne.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Sparks shower across black basalt as heavy tongs plunge white-hot steel into brine-vats.

camera_notes: Close-up on glowing blade emerging from floor fissure, pulling back to frame Vok and Rowan in orange rim-light.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Three jagged obsidian pylons beam crimson light toward the distant dome of the Threshold.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: Those beacons siphon heat from the deep vents to keep the Gauntlet's ward-barriers impenetrable.

lines.speaker: field-ash-scout
lines.line: Each pylon is guarded by cinder-hounds and ridge-snipers—approach through the cooled lava-tubes.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Split the company or hit them one by one—just bring those red beams down before nightfall.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Demolition charges at the base, wards overhead. Darken the crags.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Ash swirls around silent figures descending into the black volcanic fissures.

camera_notes: Long telephoto pan connecting the three glowing red beacons across the dark caldera ridge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Inside a soot-stained watch-alcove, bound vellum ledgers lie stacked beside an iron brazier.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: My own signature rests on every tax-roll that starved Thornwick to feed the Ember Court's rituals.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Burning the ledgers won't restore the eyes you gave to the hearth-ash, Elias.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: No—but it strips Malrik of the blood-liens he uses to bind the First Watch against us.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Let the old bailiff burn his past. We need clear paths beneath the Threshold, not paper ghosts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Blue flames consume the inked vellum as faint spectral chimes fade into silence.

camera_notes: Tight two-shot over the glowing brazier, watching blue embers drift upward as the pages turn to ash.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Twin colossi of blackened bronze flank the Gauntlet's triple portcullis above a river of slow magma.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Two hundred Ironcamp veterans died on this causeway last winter. Today we finish their march.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Aim for the ankle-hinges on those siege-golems—my slag-picks will crack their bronze pins.

lines.speaker: field-ash-scout
lines.line: Enemy reserves massing behind the inner gate! Once the portcullis drops, there's no stepping back!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Company, form wedge! Break the hinges and carry our banner through the smoke!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Prism-powder charges detonate against the iron bars as molten sparks rain across raised shields.

camera_notes: Epic wide shot of the narrow basalt causeway over glowing magma, zooming swiftly into the exploding portcullis.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Rows of frost-rimed soldiers stand motionless in wall-niches along the Threshold's obsidian gallery.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: The First Watch—sealed in stasis three centuries ago when the Schism split the crown.

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: Look at their unit plates. Half my sergeants carry the exact same family crests.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Arch-Mage Malrik plans to wake them as mindless thralls. We sever his ritual conduits first.

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Honest soldiers deserve quiet graves, not a sorcerer's leash. Lead on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Bootsteps echo sharply down the glass corridor as arcane lanterns flare pale violet ahead.

camera_notes: Slow tracking shot parallel to the frozen First Watch niches, reflections gleaming on polished obsidian.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Beneath a cracked dome open to swirling ash, Ashkarath stands beside the blazing Anchor Seals.

lines.speaker: npc-elias-penitent
lines.line: Malrik's codices lie open on the lectern—one more cycle and the caldera swallows every northern province!

lines.speaker: npc-rowan-commander
lines.line: My shield-line will hold his ember-guard! Take your company straight to the Dais!

lines.speaker: npc-vok-forgemaster
lines.line: Strike the seals while they're white-hot—cooled slag won't crack!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: For Thornwick, for the First Watch, and every name on the roll—end this now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: The Obsidian Dais trembles with a deafening roar as steel and sorcery collide before the throne.

camera_notes: Dramatic circular orbit around the company stepping onto the Dais steps as magma flares behind Ashkarath.
